issue.title: Stuck in the updates pop-up
body: A "Get Friday updates" pop-up opens on the event page. When I press Tab, focus just loops between the email field and Subscribe.
The × doesn't take focus and Escape doesn't close it. I had to reload the page, and the pop-up came right back. I never got to Register.

task.instruction: Select "Move focus into the page" and try to reach "Register for Friday" behind the pop-up. When you're stuck, press Escape.
task.afterReproduce: Focus is trapped and Escape does nothing. Keeping focus inside an open pop-up is fine; there just has to be a way out.

options.label: Add title="Close" to the span
options.feedback: A tooltip only shows on mouse hover. The span still can't be reached with Tab.

options.label: Add tabindex="0" to the span
options.feedback: Focus can land on it now, but Enter does nothing, and a screen reader reads it as "times" or "multiplication sign".

options.label: Change it to a <button> with aria-label="Close"
options.feedback: A real button, reachable with Tab and announced as "Close, button".

fixes.title: Script: keyboard handling for the pop-up

options.label: Remove the focus trap
options.feedback: Now focus wanders behind a pop-up that's still covering the page, and Escape still does nothing. The trap was fine; the missing exit is the problem.

options.label: Close the pop-up automatically after 10 seconds
options.feedback: A timer takes control away from people, and 10 seconds isn't enough for everyone to read and decide (WCAG 2.2.1).

options.label: Keep the trap and close the pop-up on Escape
options.feedback: Focus stays in the pop-up while it's open, Escape closes it, and focus returns to the button that opened it.

merged.reply: Escape closes it now, and the × is reachable too. I'm registered. Thanks for not making me reload five times again.
learn: Keeping focus inside an open dialog is good practice, as long as there's always a way out.
Escape should close a dialog, and focus should return to whatever opened it.
Close buttons need to be real buttons with a name, not a symbol in a span.
